items.text: Chicago acquired DT Jeffery Simmons from Tennessee; GM Ryan Poles expects him to debut Monday.

Chicago (final report, Saturday): OUT: RB Kyle Monangai (toe/thumb). QUESTIONABLE: CB Malik Muhammad (toe), LB D'Marco Jackson (ankle). TE Colston Loveland and LB T.J. Edwards have no designation. TE Cole Kmet is on season-ending IR.

Seattle (Friday practice): LT Charles Cross (ankle) and LB Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) are ruled out, so Josh Jones starts at LT. WR Rashid Shaheed (knee) missed Thursday and Friday and is likely out. RB Jadarian Price was full and 'realistic' to be activated; RB Zach Charbonnet dropped to limited; DT Byron Murphy II (back) was added as limited. New LG Quenton Nelson practiced fully. Official designations due Saturday.
